title: fix(spec): a refusal code or reason is literal at save only when its quote closes the value
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao6KhaLUWiS7aqNWvg6hcE74)_

Fixes #36670
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibykc1XS5J4B4J16dLb

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Clause-② citation, the published docblock of `hookRefusalCodesThrownIn` (`packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusal-codes.ts`) on `origin/main` 3e8edf78: "A code that arrives any other way — a helper's parameter (`refuse('…', code)`), a variable, a computed value — is left to the run-time refusal". A code or reason built from a literal (`'OVER' + suffix`, `'OVER'.concat(suffix)`) is a computed value, so its save refusal was a false refusal; this PR removes only that, as PR #36666 did for the text-key reader (#35698) on the same ground. Every literal refused before is still refused, in the same words (the lit pins below).

## 维护者速读
- 搭建者在钩子或动作代码里用拼接方式拼出拒绝码或拒绝原因时，保存不再被误拒；直接写死的拒绝码和原因照旧在保存时检查，用户无其它感知变化。
- 属于钩子与动作「按声明的拒绝目录拒绝」这条线，替写拼接拒绝码的搭建者解决保存被误拒的问题，和已合并的文本键同类修复是一族。
- 出错的话，拼接出的码或原因若没有声明，会在运行时才报错并点名它(本来就有的运行时拒绝)；改动可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- The four save-time readers in `packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusal-codes.ts` (`CODE_PROPERTY`, `CODE_ASSIGNMENT`, `REASON_PROPERTY`, `REASON_ASSIGNMENT`), which both save doors use (`HookSchema` and `ActionSchema`, through `hookRefusalCodesThrownIn` / `hookRefusalReasonsThrownIn`), now end with a lookahead after the closing quote:
  - `PROPERTY_VALUE_END` (the two property readers): `,` or `}` follows, after optional whitespace (a comment there is blanked to whitespace by the existing masking first).
  - `ASSIGNMENT_VALUE_END` (the two assignment readers): `;`, `,`, `}` or `)` follows after optional whitespace, or the source ends, or a line end follows whose next line does not continue the expression. A next line opening with an operator, a member access, a call or index bracket or a template (`+ suffix`, `.concat(suffix)`) continues it, as JavaScript reads it.
- Anything else after the quote leaves the value to the run-time refusal, which already names the code or reason (`undeclaredHookRefusalAtRun`, `undeclaredHookRefusalReasonAtRun` and the action twins).
- A reason under a computed code is no longer read either: the existing rule reads a property reason only beside exactly one literal code, and a computed code is no longer one.
- A template literal with a `${}` hole needed no change: the masking already blanks it. Pinned anyway (property form).
- `,` is in the assignment set beyond the card's list (`e.code = 'X', e.reason = 'y'`): the comma operator ends the assignment, and leaving it out would have stopped refusing a literal the save refuses today.
- Docblocks of the two lookaheads and of `hookRefusalCodesThrownIn` / `hookRefusalReasonsThrownIn` say what "literal" means now. No export, schema shape, `.describe()` or error sentence changed.
- `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec`.

## Tests
One new top-level `describe` in each existing harness file:
- `packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusals.test.ts`:
  - **lit code** (13 shapes): property closed by `}`, by `,`, with a line break or a comment before the close, a backtick with no hole, inside `Object.assign`; assignment closed by `;`, a line end, a comment and a line end, `,`, `}`, `)`, the source end. Each is still refused at `body.source` with the unchanged sentence.
  - **dark code** (9 shapes plus an inline handler): property `+`, `+` on the next line, backtick `+`, `.concat`, template hole; assignment `+`, `+` on the next line, `.concat` on the next line, backtick `+`. Each passes the save, and the reader returns nothing.
  - **lit reason** (5) / **dark reason** (5): the same split for reasons, a listed reason (`reasons: [{ reason }]`) included.
  - **CONTROL**: a literal code beside a computed one in the same body is still refused, exactly once.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action-refusals.test.ts`: the action twin, lit code 5, dark code 4, lit reason 2, dark reason 2.

<details><summary>Before the fix, after, and ablation</summary>

- Before (new pins on the `origin/main` 3e8edf78 reader, file restored tree-only): `Failed Tests 20`, all dark cases except the template hole (already blanked by the masking); every lit case green.
- After, at 291adbd7: the two harness files `Tests  195 passed (195)`; together with `hook.test.ts`, `hook-texts.test.ts`, `action-texts.test.ts` before the new pins, `Tests  326 passed (326)`.
- Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed fix (tests import `src` relatively, so no dist leg); each restore `blob == HEAD (9afc30eb45f3) and git diff HEAD is empty`:
  - `REASON_PROPERTY` lookahead removed: `Tests  4 failed | 191 passed (195)`, the 4 property-reason dark pins.
  - `REASON_ASSIGNMENT` lookahead removed: `3 failed`, the assignment-reason dark pins.
  - `CODE_PROPERTY` lookahead removed: `7 failed`, the property-code dark pins and the handler pin.
  - `CODE_ASSIGNMENT` lookahead removed: `6 failed`, the assignment-code dark pins.
  - Line-end branch made non-continuing (`[ \t]*\r?\n` only): `4 failed`, the next-line dark pins.
  - Line-end branch removed: `4 failed`, the line-end lit pins (hook code ×2, action code, hook reason).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` at 291adbd7: `Test Files  909 passed (909)`, `Tests  28797 passed | 1 todo (28798)`; `typecheck` exit 0; `check:generated` exit 0 ("All 14 generated artifacts are up to date").
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- Derived local gate set at 291adbd7: `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles 85 derived, 83 run (all exit 0), 2 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/objectql` were built first so `check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:lean-entry-closure` could measure (both exit 0). `eslint` on the three changed `.ts` files exit 0.
- Declared narrowing, the 2 NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite not met), both CI's: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` reads a fixture pinned to a commit this shallow clone cannot reach; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs every package's `dist/` (a full `pnpm build`), which this card's diff does not move.
- The assignment terminators add `,` to the card's list (`;`, line end, `}`, `)`): the comma operator closes the assignment (`e.code = 'X', e.reason = 'y'`), and leaving it out would have stopped refusing a literal the save refuses today. A line end counts unless the next line continues the expression; the continuation set is the operator, member-access, bracket and template openers JavaScript does not end a statement before, broader than the claim's "a leading `+` or `.`" example.
- Out of scope, noted not filed: none found.

## Verification
Read first (by risk):
1. `packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusal-codes.ts`: `PROPERTY_VALUE_END` and `ASSIGNMENT_VALUE_END`, and the four readers that append them.
2. `packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusals.test.ts`: the new lit/dark/CONTROL describe at the end.
3. `packages/spec/src/ui/action-refusals.test.ts`: the action twin.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/hook-refusals.test.ts src/ui/action-refusals.test.ts` shows 195 passing; delete `+ PROPERTY_VALUE_END` from `CODE_PROPERTY` and the same command shows 7 dark cases failing.
